description: Keller Rinaudo Cliffton thinks we’re already experiencing the technology of tomorrow, just that it’s not evenly distributed... About a decade ago, Keller transformed his smartphone robot company into Zipline, which today orchestrates on-demand drone deliveries all over the world. Zipline got its start delivering critical medical supplies to hospitals in Rwanda: a testament to Keller’s belief that innovation is already improving lives outside the U.S. This week on How I Built This Lab , Keller re…
classificationReason: A founder interview centered on Zipline’s delivery drones, deployment, development challenges, and commercial expansion.
qualityReason: Likely substantive original interview covering product development, operations, and commercialization.
